title: Let's Build a Simple Shulker Crafter
description:
We've been doing a lot of complex redstone, and even trying to scratch the surface of my design process is extremely exhausting. So in this video we switch things up by tackling a redstone problem that is relatively simple and breaking it down like a professional tech player.
